$comment: The three territories this register covers, kept deliberately APART. NYC+Westchester is the delivered dataset and keeps the original file paths at data/*.json — nothing about it moves, so nothing about it breaks. Each newer territory owns a directory beside it and is collected, validated and published on its own. They are never merged: coverage, opt-out rules and menu-platform mix all differ by region, and one blended figure would hide every difference. A territory names EITHER the counties it contains or the ones it excludes — upstate is defined by exclusion on purpose, so a county that issues its first licence tomorrow is covered instead of silently dropped by a list written today.

territories.label: New York City & Westchester
territories.note: The original scope. Its files stay at data/*.json — do not move them.

territories.label: Upstate New York
territories.note: Everything above Westchester to the Canadian border — defined as every county that is neither the original scope nor Long Island.

territories.label: Long Island
territories.note: Suffolk and Nassau. Neither upstate nor in the original scope; kept separate so it is never silently folded into either.
